title: The smoke rig cannot start on this machine: four fixes under scripts/smoke/
plan: .legion/plan.json (planner commit 3f5aba4c); all five refinementsToSpec accepted by the architect and implemented; the forward-mode addition from spec v13 folded into Tasks 4 and 5

pr.head: legion/LEGION-10
pr.baseline: 7db2cd83 (main at planning time; main has since advanced but touched nothing under scripts/smoke/, so no rebase was needed)

commits.message: test(smoke): up.test.sh runs the real daemon loader against the generated legion.yaml
fix(smoke): force root-issue creation past Dispatch's near-duplicate check
fix(smoke): up.sh resolves the rpc-fix OMP build in preflight and fails closed without one
fix(smoke): none and forward modes block the Dispatch-fed checkpoints 1-4 and 12 with their own reason
docs(smoke): README says what none and forward modes exercise, names envoy for checkpoints 1-4 and 12, documents LEGION_OMP_PATH resolution
test(smoke): down.test.sh proves forward-mode teardown (process group and hook record)

whatLanded.up.sh: ensure_root_issue sends force: true (comment explains the near-duplicate check; curl --fail path unchanged). New resolve_omp_path (after resolve_webhook_mode): LEGION_OMP_PATH must be absolute+file+executable, else fail; unset -> ${XDG_STATE_HOME:-$HOME/.local/state}/legion/sjawhar-legion/omp/omp-18.1.15-sami.9bff2014-rpcfix if executable, else fail naming the default path and both remedies; never falls back to the pin. main(): omp_path resolved right after webhook_mode (before mkdir/write_daemon_config/go build/ensure_nats), prints `GREEN OMP build: <path>`, exports LEGION_OMP_PATH only in the daemon start_process env block. omp_pin value unchanged (comment added). webhook_ingress_block_reason text replaced with the spec's none-mode reason (verbatim sharedText.upShNoneModeReason).
whatLanded.checkpoints.sh: New dispatch_ingress_block_reason <mode> after webhook_ingress_block_reason. The mode gate now stores webhook_mode once (readonly) and has three arms: none -> 1|2|3|4|12 blocked with the Dispatch-ingress reason, 5|6|7|9|10|11 with the existing GitHub-ingress reason; forward -> 1|2|3|4|12 blocked with the Dispatch-ingress reason; envoy -> nothing; anything else fails as before. 8 and 13 untouched. The block runs before any curl and before checkpoint_twelve's require_env SMOKE_QUEUED_ISSUE.
whatLanded.README.md: Line 3 says envoy bridges GitHub events and Dispatch issue events. Inputs-table SMOKE_WEBHOOK_MODE row and the Human-controlled gates rows for envoy/forward/none rewritten: forward = live GitHub events only (1-4 and 12 SKIPPED-BLOCKED, 5-7 and 9-11 available, default when gh webhook forward is installed); none = start-up, fail-closed OMP probe, controller spawn, checkpoint 13; envoy = the only mode for 1-4 and 12. Start-and-stop paragraph gains the none-mode sentence and the restored forward sentence (the literal U+2026 truncation is gone; the bare bun-run code block has its lead-in again) plus a forward-relays-GitHub-only clause. New paragraph 'Which OMP build the rig runs' after the LEGION_*_PATH paragraph; the mise-where sentence points to it. Checkpoints paragraph rewritten; 'envoy and forward both count as live ingress' no longer exists. The `down.sh also succeeds in none mode` sentence is unchanged.
whatLanded.up.test.sh: Cases A/B after the launch-prefix cases (real --check-config accepts the generated file; rejects a merge: human fixture). resolve_omp_path unit block after the webhook-mode PASS (explicit executable passes through; explicit missing fails; relative fails; unset+fake XDG_STATE_HOME resolves to the default; unset+no default fails naming path and both remedies). Final section: start_process stub records argv per process; negative main() run with a missing LEGION_OMP_PATH proves nothing starts; export LEGION_OMP_PATH=fake omp for the successful run; asserts the GREEN OMP build line, LEGION_OMP_PATH in the daemon argv only, and the pinned omp_invocation line; force: true assertion on the captured root-issue body; the webhook_ingress_block_reason assertion compares the new text verbatim.
whatLanded.checkpoints.test.sh: Fixture records envoy for the checkpoint 1-4 OK cases and for the bare-dir root-issue case. New none block: records none, loops 1 2 3 4 12 (exit 3, `CHECKPOINT <n> SKIPPED-BLOCKED: SMOKE_WEBHOOK_MODE=none: ...requires Dispatch issue-event ingress...use SMOKE_WEBHOOK_MODE=envoy`), asserts zero new curl calls, then checkpoint 13 OK under none. Existing checkpoint-5 none/envoy block unchanged (PASS text renamed). New forward block after it: records forward, same loop with the reason naming SMOKE_WEBHOOK_MODE=forward, zero curl calls, checkpoint 5 reaches its own PR-fixture check (exit 1, `set SMOKE_PR or open a legion/issue-* pull request`), then restores envoy for the later cases.
whatLanded.down.test.sh: cleanup() also kills a recorded forward_pgid. New forward case: `setsid bash -c 'printf "%s\n" "$$" >"$1"; exec sleep 300' _ <pidfile> &` reports its own post-setsid pid; the harness waits for the file, refuses to continue unless that pid is its own process-group leader (/proc/<pid>/stat field 5), writes webhook-forward.pid/.start/.hook, installs a logging fake gh, runs down.sh with SMOKE_REPO set, and asserts the group is dead, the three records are gone, `api -X DELETE repos/example-org/legion-smoke/hooks/7` was issued, and RIG DOWN printed.

deviationsFromPlan.what: Takes the recorded mode as its argument and prints `SMOKE_WEBHOOK_MODE=<mode>: ...` instead of hard-coding `none`.
deviationsFromPlan.why: The architect added the forward arm reusing the same reason; a hard-coded `SMOKE_WEBHOOK_MODE=none:` prefix would print a false mode name under forward. For none the output is the spec's sharedText verbatim; for forward it reads `SMOKE_WEBHOOK_MODE=forward: this checkpoint requires Dispatch issue-event ingress; no Dispatch issue event reaches the rig NATS, so the daemon never admits the root issue; use SMOKE_WEBHOOK_MODE=envoy`.

deviationsFromPlan.what: Runs as `preflight_status="$(set +e; (set -e; LEGION_OMP_PATH=... main) >file 2>&1; echo $?)"` instead of the plan's `if (LEGION_OMP_PATH=... main); then`.
deviationsFromPlan.why: resolve_omp_path's fail() runs inside `omp_path="$(...)"`; only `set -e` turns that failed substitution into an abort of main(), and bash suppresses -e for everything executed as an `if` condition (probe /tmp/legion10-e-probe.sh reproduced it: the plan's form let main() continue to RIG READY). The real up.sh runs under set -e and does stop; the harness form now mirrors that. Commented in the harness.

deviationsFromPlan.what: No assertion on a `STOPPED webhook-forward (pgid ...)` line; asserts RIG DOWN instead.
deviationsFromPlan.why: down.sh's terminate_process_group_file prints STOPPED only on its 10-second KILL fallback (after the TERM'd group is already gone it `return 0`s silently). A sleep dies on TERM at once, so the planned assertion can never hold without changing down.sh, which is out of scope.

deviationsFromPlan.what: The stand-in reports its own pid from inside the new session and the harness verifies pid == pgid before writing the pid record.
deviationsFromPlan.why: Reading /proc/$!/stat right after `setsid sleep 300 &` races the setsid() call: an early read returns the harness's own process group, and down.sh would then `kill -- -<that pgid>` — the harness itself and possibly the operator's shell.

deviationsFromPlan.what: Loops 1 2 3 4 12 (not just checkpoint 1) and asserts zero Dispatch requests, mirroring the none case.
deviationsFromPlan.why: Same code path, one loop; the architect asked for at least checkpoint 1 and checkpoint 5 passing the gate — both included.

deviationsFromPlan.what: `fix(smoke): the smoke rig can start on this machine again (LEGION-10)` instead of the plan's shorthand-heavy title.
deviationsFromPlan.why: Sami's rule for human-read text: plain English, no coined nouns.

notRun: The real up.sh was not run against this machine (tester's job per the assignment). forward mode was not run (no personal GitHub login).
testerNotes: Follow plan.json testerE2E E1-E7 as written; nothing in it is invalidated. Use a fresh SMOKE_DIR so ${SMOKE_DIR}/root-issue is absent, `unset LEGION_OMP_PATH` first (the worker pane exports one), SMOKE_PROJECT=sjawhar/24.

Expected none-mode checkpoint line, exactly: `CHECKPOINT <n> SKIPPED-BLOCKED: SMOKE_WEBHOOK_MODE=none: this checkpoint requires Dispatch issue-event ingress; no Dispatch issue event reaches the rig NATS, so the daemon never admits the root issue; use SMOKE_WEBHOOK_MODE=envoy` then exit 3, for n in 1 2 3 4 12; checkpoint 13 OK (needs no DISPATCH_TOKEN).

down.sh prints `STOPPED <name> (pid ...)` / `(pgid ...)` ONLY when a process ignored TERM for 10 s and was KILLed; a process that exits on TERM is stopped silently. Do not read a missing STOPPED line as a teardown failure — verify with the tmux/docker/ss checks in E4 instead. (plan.json E4's `expect` lists STOPPED lines; they appear only if the daemon/listener take >10 s to exit.)

The daemon writes no dedicated controller-ready log line; acceptance 3's evidence is the persisted `roles[legion-sjawhar24-controller]` claim in state.json plus the `[legion] resync complete:` line from /controller/ready's forced resync, /proc/<pid>/exe of the controller, and 0 hits for `send did not invoke the agent` (plan E2).
